I stand here humble and thankful for the journey that I have been through and survived! The battle of addiction has been the hardest thing I have ever had to go through! It took losing everything and almost my life,for me to change my life and ask for help. Sometimes you have to fall, and lose it all,to truly find yourself and most of all, love yourself.

I look back now and see this innocent child,clueless to the world, searching for something to make him happy, and found the only happiness was masked in a bottle, that would soon lead him to destruction. It’s crazy how fast I fell apart and how the disease took over. The only thing I cared about was that drink and nothing else mattered. The power of addiction will kill you if you let it, and it almost killed me right before I made up my mind that it was not going to beat me.

I was doubted by everyone and told that I couldn’t do it! Well, I stand here now #1yearsober, from 100 proof, to living proof, #wedorecover and #sobriety is the greatest thing that has ever happened to me!!!
